search_perplexity_search: search using the Perplexity API with an API key, query string, and result count to return a list of SearchResult objects
search_perplexity_search_with_filter: search using the Perplexity API with a domain filter list to limit results to specific domains
search_perplexity_search_with_user_heade: search using the Perplexity API while forwarding user info headers for authenticated requests
search_perplexity_search_custom_url: search using a custom Perplexity API URL instead of the default endpoint
search_perplexity_search_error_handling: search using the Perplexity API with built-in error handling that logs errors and returns an empty list on failure
